review:
Money Stacks is a 6x4 retro slot with cherries, watermelons and red sevens; the purple wild appears on reels 2 to 6. Diamond cash symbols carry up to 25x, and Minor, Major and Grand icons offer up to 2,500x.

Whenever a strike collect symbol lands on reel one or six, all cash values are collected. Golden sevens lead to one of two bonus rounds, including a classic free spins feature where up to six scatters trigger 30 spins with multipliers. Pragmatic Play advertises up to 5,000x. The RTP is 96.55%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
